AI Generator Video — first public release.

- Instantly turn text or images into 1080p AI-generated videos, including product promos and social content
- Simple workflow: upload photos and description, describe your desired video, and receive a ready-to-download MP4 in 1–2 minutes
- Auto connects to the video processing API using a secure, anonymous token
- Supports credits management, timeline editing, file uploads, and exports via clear user prompts
- Seamless cloud rendering—no local setup required, supports major video and image formats
